cheng: Quick sync — thinking about sidecarless tenant CP rollout. Key risks: DNS delegation flapping and cert rotation KMS storms. Short proposals?

alex: NS delegation for ownership. Detect partial delegation with probes across 5 public resolvers; if mismatch >90s, mark partial and enable fallback DNS for endpoint records only. TTLs 60s.

maria: Certs: batch rotations per-region with a 30s window and a token-bucket limiter per-tenant (default 5 ops/min). Controller returns async op id. Expose metrics: cert_batches, avg_batch_ms, kms_errors.

sanjay: Add manual whitelist path: if tenant flag "whitelist_required" true, controller waits for customer ack (webhook) before activation. Also circuit-breaker: if KMS error rate >3% for 2m pause rotations.

cheng: Rollout flow suggestion: 1) provision CP with weight=0; 2) push glue/ns; 3) probe DNS until >=90% agreement; 4) health gating (95% checks) then flip to weight=100; 5) if mismatch rollback to weight=0 and disable delegation. Keep steps idempotent.

alex: CLI runbook snippet: `redwoodctl cp set-weight --tenant $T --cp $ID --weight 0` then after checks `--weight 100`. Always gate on probe success.

maria: Add metric labels for batch_size and batch_window so ops can tune.

sanjay: Ops limit: concurrent delegations per-org <=3 to reduce churn.

cheng: Actions: maria/sanjay draft cert-controller API + batching; alex write DNS probe/playbook; I'll prototype fallback DNS in staging. Follow-up next Tue. :thumbsup:
